I lost all my data. Terrible Experience with Tiny Invoice Do Not Trust This App for Serious Business

I used Tiny Invoice for over five years when it was completely free, and it worked great. Last year, they switched to a paid subscription model, and since the app had been very reliable for me, I decided to pay for the full year. That was a huge mistake.

As soon as it became a paid service, the system quality dropped significantly. The app became unstable, and the customer service is terrible there is no way to speak with a real person, only email support that takes days to respond.

Three weeks ago, I changed phones. When I logged into Tiny Invoice on my new device, the app showed a blank account all my data was gone. Over 5 years of records, more than 3,000 invoices and estimates, payment history everything disappeared. I have no idea who still owes me money or how to recover any of it.

After a week of sending emails, support finally responded saying that I manually deleted all my data. That is completely ridiculous. They also said there is no way to recover anything. I immediately canceled my subscription, but since I had already paid for the full year, they still haven’t refunded me a cent.

Final Warning: If you are a very small business just starting out, this app might be okay short-term. But if you are a growing or established business I DO NOT RECOMMEND Tiny Invoice at all. It is too risky to trust your business data to them.
I have now switched to Square let’s see how that goes, but Tiny Invoice is definitely not an option for me anymore.
